title: Evidence AI has attained Superintelligence in one field, Mathematics, and what this means to Law and Society — Part One of Three
content_md: The article examines AI’s reported breakthrough on the Navier–Stokes problem, where thousands of coordinated agents generated and formally checked an original mathematical approach. Although humans must still verify meaning, attribution, and correctness, mathematician Tristan Buckmaster views the achievement as a domain-specific “superintelligence” milestone. The story highlights human-guided collaboration, verification, and implications for law. Article Link: Tristan Buckmaster and AI’s Mathematical Superintelligence Breakthrough
